race.comment: Very tough for the late-season 2yos with a lot of handy ones resuming against a few later types. RESOLUTELY (8) has run second either side of a spell but the debut was behind Guest House and she ran very well fresh at Flemington over 1200m. Fancy she'll be much better for that and 1100m suits. GHANA'S AKAN (1) had four starts in her maiden campaign and ran well each time in good races, sent out favourite on debut in the Geelong Diamond. Tough draw, watch the betting. REBEL TUESDAY (4) resumes having measured up well behind Medicinal before a spell which is good form. MILSONS POINT (2) didn't quite measure up to the top last time in but has trialled very sharply and might be a big improver this time around.
